download.appIntro: Would you like to create and save BolinhoMod projects without an internet connection? Download the free BolinhoMod app.
download.howDoIInstall: How do I install BolinhoMod Desktop?
download.whenSupportLinuxApp: When will you have the BolinhoMod app available for Linux?
download.whenSupportLinux: When will you have BolinhoMod Desktop for Linux?
download.supportLinuxAnswer: BolinhoMod Desktop on Linux is currently not supported. We are working with partners and the open-source community to determine if there is a way we can support Linux in the future. Stay tuned!
download.whenSupportLinuxAppAnswer: The BolinhoMod app is currently not supported on Linux. We are working with partners and the open-source community to determine if there is a way we can support Linux in the future. Stay tuned!
download.supportChromeOS: When will you have BolinhoMod Desktop for Chromebooks?
download.supportChromeOSAnswer: BolinhoMod Desktop for Chromebooks is not yet available. We are working on it and expect to release later in 2019.
download.olderVersions: Looking for an earlier version of BolinhoMod?
download.cannotAccessMacStore: What if I can't access the Mac App Store?
download.cannotAccessWindowsStore: What if I can't access the Microsoft Store?
download.macMoveAppToApplications: Open the .dmg file. Move BolinhoMod 3 into Applications.
download.macMoveToApplications: Open the .dmg file. Move BolinhoMod Desktop into Applications.
download.doIHaveToDownload: Do I have to download an app to use BolinhoMod?
download.doIHaveToDownloadAnswer: No. You can also use the BolinhoMod project editor in most web browsers on most devices by going to scratch.mit.edu and clicking "Create".
download.canIUseScratchLink: Can I use BolinhoMod Link to connect to extensions?
download.canIUseScratchLinkAnswer: Yes. However, you will need an Internet connection to use BolinhoMod Link.
download.canIUseExtensions: Can I connect to hardware extensions?
download.canIUseExtensionsAnswer: Yes. With the BolinhoMod app you can connect to extensions, and you do not need BolinhoMod Link.
download.howConnectHardwareDevices: How do I connect the BolinhoMod app to hardware devices?
download.howConnectHardwareDevicesAnswer: You will need to install and run BolinhoMod Link in order to connect to hardware devices when using BolinhoMod app for {operatingsystem}. You will also need an internet connection to use BolinhoMod Link.
With the BolinhoMod app you can connect to hardware devices like the micro:bit or LEGO Boost. When using the BolinhoMod app for {operatingsystem} you do not need BolinhoMod Link.
download.desktopAndBrowser: Can I use BolinhoMod Desktop and also have BolinhoMod open in the browser?
download.appAndBrowser: Can I use the BolinhoMod app and also have BolinhoMod open in the browser?
download.onPhone: Can I install BolinhoMod on my Android phone?
download.onPhoneAnswer: No. The current version of BolinhoMod for Android only works on tablets.
download.howUpdateApp: How do I update the BolinhoMod app?
download.howUpdateAppAnswerPlayStore: Open the Google Play store and check for updates. If your installation is managed by school administrators, they will need to update the version and make the update available to managed devices.
download.howUpdateAppAnswerDownload: To update BolinhoMod for {operatingsystem} from this page, download the latest version and install. To check which version you have, click the BolinhoMod logo in the downloaded app.
download.canIShare: Can I share from BolinhoMod Desktop?
download.canIShareAnswer: This isn’t supported currently. For now, you can save a project from BolinhoMod Desktop, upload it to your BolinhoMod account, and share it there. In a later version we will add the ability to upload to your BolinhoMod account directly in BolinhoMod Desktop.
download.canIShareApp: Can I share to the online community from the BolinhoMod app for {operatingsystem}?
download.canIShareAnswerPlayStore: Yes. Click the 3-dots menu on a project in the lobby and select "Share" from the options. In addition to sharing by email, you can sign in to your BolinhoMod account and share a project to the BolinhoMod online community.
download.canIShareAnswerDownloaded: Sharing directly to online community from the BolinhoMod app for {operatingsystem} is not currently supported. For now, you can export a project from the BolinhoMod app, then log onto the BolinhoMod website, and upload and share your project there.
download.whyNoDevicesVisible: Why doesn't BolinhoMod show any devices when I try to connect hardware extensions?
download.whyNoDevicesVisibleAnswer: We’ve found that turning your {devicePosessive} bluetooth off and on again in the system settings usually allows you to see hardware devices again. If the problem persists, check that Location services are enabled for your device. If you still do not see any devices, please {whyNoDevicesContactUsLink}.
download.whyAskForLocation: Why is {operatingsystem} asking for my location?
download.whyAskForLocationAnswer: BolinhoMod uses bluetooth to connect to other devices, such as a micro:bit or LEGO BOOST.  Bluetooth can be used to provide location data to the app, so Google requires every app that uses bluetooth ask users for permission to access their location. BolinhoMod will not use bluetooth to track your location.
download.whereProjectStored: Where does the BolinhoMod App store my projects?
download.whereProjectStoredAnswer: Projects are saved internally in the app. To export a project file, click the 3-dot menu and select "Share". On the next screen select "export". The options visible depend on the applications installed on your device. Common options are Google Drive, Files, and email.
